original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: A written rank-nine theorem for changed directed P112 masks with both rational decoder spaces inside the retained root code and both binary pairing spaces inside the retained binary-label code.
scope_change_reason: The attempt to lower the complex window through a nonsymmetric decoder produced a complete obstruction for this coordinate-code family. This is a structural side result, not a new helper inventory or a passed positive-budget gate.
bottleneck_link: A rank-eight directed pairing could alter the local cost interface. The theorem excludes obtaining it by coefficient changes inside both retained codes; a constructive attempt must change at least one code or another hypothesis.
stop_rule: Finish the scoped proof, exact finite premises, controls and source-bound replay. Preserve the broader research objective and do not identify this theorem with an exponent improvement.
evidence: README proof; source-bound verify.py checks two quadratic ranks, all 255 nonconstant cut systems over two primes, the tetrad contradiction premises, the predecessor clique certificate and positive/corrupted controls.
author: Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in exploration, proof, implementation and prose. Read-only subagents derived the tetrad argument and checked geometry. No independent human review.

open_questions.question: Can a directed pairing outside at least one retained coordinate code yield a lower-cost native unit?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem leaves such changes open while excluding coefficient deformations inside both codes.
open_questions.first_step: Give explicit rational decoder and binary source/receiver factors, verify every diagonal and required zero and the exact ranks, then price the centre and restored side word before global assembly.
open_questions.blocked_by: No outside-code candidate or complete paid native word has been found. A fitting pair alone would not establish a supplier.
